title: Ghar mei Chor Ghus aaye Hamare Peeche, Pura Ghar Chhan mara hamara
description:
The Prank Idea: Neetu reveals that she is going to prank Lakhan by pretending their house was burglarized while he was away in Delhi. She mentions getting the idea from her followers on Snapchat.
 Setting the Scene: Neetu and her team start creating a fake crime scene. They pull out drawers, throw books on the floor, scatter everyday items, and make the living room look thoroughly ransacked to make the robbery look convincing.
The Emergency Call: After the setup is complete, Neetu waits downstairs and calls Lakhan, urging him to rush back home immediately because of a major "problem."
[09:40] Lakhan Arrives: Lakhan reaches the apartment and is greeted by the mess. Neetu and her friends try to act shocked, claiming they were in a different section of the house when the "robbery" occurred.
Catching On: Lakhan's detective skills kick in quickly, and he becomes suspicious. He points out the logical flaws—like how the doors aren't broken, how a thief wouldn't just throw books on the floor if they were looking for valuables, and how it's impossible for an intruder to climb into their balcony unnoticed.
The Reveal: To call her bluff, Lakhan dials his mother to tell her about the "robbery." Knowing the prank has gone too far, Neetu breaks character, bursts into laughter, and runs away, officially admitting it was all a setup.
 The Aftermath: Lakhan gloats about figuring out the prank so easily and playfully challenges Neetu to actually succeed at pranking him in the future. The vlog wraps up with them checking out some small gifts brought by their friend Diksha and asking their viewers for better prank ideas.
